entities.label: MDAP portfolio cost growth
entities.finding: Combined total estimates increased by $49.3 billion for 30 major defense acquisition programs also included in the prior assessment.

entities.label: Sentinel estimate growth concentration
entities.finding: GAO reported that the Air Force Sentinel missile program accounted for more than $36 billion, or 73 percent, of the $49.3 billion portfolio increase.
